==Experience and points balance==
Once you have enough points to buy a large amount of absorption and overload potions, it is highly recommended to use them for each run, as they provide the strongest boosts and longest AFK time at no cost. After your first few runs, points are very sustainable and you will make up for the points spent on them. 

Normal rumbles will provide the best experience rates and most AFK time with absorption potions due to the monsters relatively low damage and defence. You will generally sustain enough points to continue to buy absorption potions and overloads.
Hard rumbles will provide the noticeably higher point rates, but will give lower experience rates and require more absorption potions due to the higher stats of the monsters. You will profit substantial amounts of points to put towards rewards.

With overloads, on Hard customisable rumbles, you can expect approximately 250,000 points per hour and melee [[experience]] of between 50,000 and 80,000 per hour at lower levels (50-75). As you gain levels and use better gear, it will continue to scale (around 800~1,000 per Attack and Strength level) with higher combat levels.
